dem_pipeline.method: AWS Terrarium SRTM tiles, generalized from fetch_dem_terrain.py to arbitrary bbox
dem_pipeline.live_fetch_probe_detail: URLError: <urlopen error Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden>
dem_pipeline.live_fetch_conclusion: BLOCKED by sandbox egress policy (403 on CONNECT to s3.amazonaws.com); matches prior independent finding against a different DEM source (docs/PHASE_0_3_CARTODEM_VALIDATION.md, bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in). No elevation/slope values were fabricated for cells outside the pre-existing VOBL cache.
dem_pipeline.coverage_note: Real DEM values exist ONLY for cells within/near the pre-existing Bengaluru/VOBL bbox (12.5-14.0N, 77.0-78.5E), reused from data/blr_terrain.json. All other cells are honestly MISSING, not proxied.

hydrology_pipeline.method: Real INDOFLOODS gauge catchment characteristics (data/catchment_characteristics_indofloods.csv), joined via the existing gauge-to-cell mapping (processed/indofloods/indofloods_grid_mapping.csv). Averaged across gauges when >1 gauge maps to the same cell. Never interpolated to ungauged cells.
hydrology_pipeline.coverage_note: 75/992 cells (7.6%) have real, gauge-derived catchment hydrology. This is inherently sparse -- India has far more than 106 distinct 1deg catchment cells -- and is NOT a claim of pan-India drainage coverage.
